notes: Read SKILL.md (791 lines) in full. Guidance for environment-aware API error responses in Next.js (generic messages in production, details only in development), with the full lib/errorHandler.ts helper code included (SKILL.md:474-547), logging/redaction advice and client-side error display.

No commands, installs, credentials, or network access; it only shapes the user's own code. Sample code reads process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY / NODE_ENV the normal way and explicitly says never to log secrets or environment variables.

Template dependence: the core helper is shipped inline, so the skill works in any Next.js project; examples also import validateRequest, idSchema/updateProfileSchema, withRateLimit and withCsrf from the Secure Vibe Coding OS starter, which are not included (see the sibling input-validation, rate-limiting and csrf-protection skills). Optional pointers to auth-security and security-testing skills.

Minor caveats: handleApiError logs the whole error object (SKILL.md:478) in production, slightly at odds with 'never log full stack traces' (575); the shallow safelog redaction only covers top-level keys; the Equifax 'detailed error messages' claim (SKILL.md:42-43) and the SANS '74%' statistic (40) are unverified.
